text_block_list.text: I show Seiun Sky the letter and present that one of her fans handed to me yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoooa, guess this means I've finally become famous.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wonder what the present is. Let's have a look-see.
She removes the wrapping, revealing a small desk clock with an alarm function.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer… is this really from a fan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Dear Seiun Sky, I love you and your unpredictable races!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "I saw you taking a nap the other day, but when I called out to you, you kept sleeping."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Feel free to use this clock so you can wake up right on time!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Hm.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: These fans are really watching me every which way I go.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna have to find a better place to chill out when I skip practice.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heeey, relax! You know I'm kidding.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, time to find the perfect place to put this clock.
The next day, Seiun Sky actually shows up at the academy with time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That alarm clock's intense. I'm no light sleeper, and that thing woke me right up.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Course… "A tool is nothing if you don't use it," is the ol' family motto.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure does! It's like the phrase, "When life gives you lemons, make lemonade."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The clock is the lemon, and I'm making lemonade. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, waking up early is nice every once in a while.
With her circadian rhythm sorted out, Seiun Sky's spirits are unusually high.
